works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 保健品电商网站：深青绿色首屏，一瓶补剂立于圆形底座正中，大字标题“Control Your Stress Hormones”直击功效；左下五星评分与 50,000+ 评价、右下产品卡片配 -20% 标识，信任背书与促销信息都放在首屏，电商落地页“卖点 + 口碑 + 折扣”三件套排布很完整。
works.comment_en: Wellness-supplements e-commerce site: a deep teal hero centers one supplement bottle on a round pedestal under the bold headline "Control Your Stress Hormones"; five-star ratings with 50,000+ reviews sit bottom-left and a product card with a -20% badge bottom-right — selling point, social proof and discount all on the first screen, a complete e-commerce hero formula.
works.title: Wellness Supplements eCommerce Website Design

works.author: Artspire
works.comment: 企业 AI 网站动效：深蓝紫渐变底，中央发光球体以连线串起多个应用图标节点，文案“Your data & systems”与“Foundation”点出平台定位；光束与节点连接的动态效果把“数据中台”这个抽象概念做成了看得见的网络，AI 企业站讲架构时值得借鉴。
works.comment_en: Enterprise AI site with motion: on a deep blue-violet gradient, a glowing orb connects to app-icon nodes, headlined "Your data & systems" and "Foundation"; the light-beam animation turns the abstract idea of a data foundation into a visible network — a strong way for an enterprise AI site to show its architecture instead of just claiming it.
works.title: Enterprise AI Website & Motion Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: SaaS 管理后台：浅灰白界面，左侧 Projects 与 Members 侧边栏，主区 In Progress / Review / Completed 三列看板；“Revamp Pricing Page UI”卡片呈拖拽状态带渐变高亮，左下角还有 AI Assistant 横幅，拖拽反馈与 AI 入口都做进了看板，SaaS 后台的任务管理可以这样加一层智能。
works.comment_en: SaaS admin panel: a light gray-white interface with Projects and Members in the left sidebar and an In Progress / Review / Completed kanban in the main area; the "Revamp Pricing Page UI" card shows a drag state with a gradient highlight, and an AI Assistant banner sits at the bottom-left — drag feedback and an AI entry point built right into the board, a good pattern for task management in SaaS backends.
works.title: SaaS Dashboard - Web Admin Panel

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 反欺诈软件仪表盘：灰绿底，左侧 12 条未处理提醒与 $4,862.17 金额的队列，中央案件 INV-4821 的交易与设备关联图谱用黄色连线串起节点；右侧交易与设备详情、底部“Block linked network”按钮，风控后台把“图谱定位 + 一键封禁”的处置链路做成了一个屏。
works.comment_en: Fraud-detection software dashboard: a gray-green screen with a queue of 12 unhandled alerts and $4,862.17 on the left, and a transaction-and-device graph for case INV-4821 in the center, nodes linked in yellow; transaction and device details on the right and a "Block linked network" button at the bottom — the whole "spot it in the graph, block it in one click" workflow fits on a single screen.
works.title: Fraud Detection Software Web App Design

works.author: Jack R. for RonDesignLab ⭐️
works.comment: Hydroflask 智能水瓶 App：深色背景衬出蓝色水瓶手机界面，“Garth's Flask”与 Mode 选项；另一屏是“今天喝了多少水？”饮水量选择页，16 / 12 / 8 盎司选项一目了然，手机外框橙粉渐变、背景颗粒感绿黄，硬件联动 App 用一枚产品图加清晰的数字选择把喝水这件事做得很轻。
works.comment_en: Hydroflask smart water-bottle app: a dark backdrop makes the blue bottle phone UI pop, showing "Garth's Flask" and Mode options; another screen asks "How much did you drink today?" with 16, 12 and 8-ounce choices at a glance, the phone framed in an orange-pink gradient over a grainy green-yellow background — a hardware companion app that keeps hydration tracking light with one product shot and clear numbers.
works.title: Hydroflask - Smart Water Bottle Mobile App

works.author: Ronald Olsen for Awsmd
works.comment: Codex AI 网站：白、黑、米、棕、橙配色，多层网站界面拼贴，古代遗迹与沙漠神庙图片配文案“Memory of mankind”“Discover what the past has preserved”；顶部 Google、Oracle、OpenAI 合作方标志条，知识类 AI 产品用考古意象讲“人类知识”，视觉记忆点很强。
works.comment_en: Codex AI website: a collage of layered site screens in white, black, beige, brown and orange, pairing images of ancient ruins and desert temples with copy like "Memory of mankind" and "Discover what the past has preserved"; a partner strip with Google, Oracle and OpenAI logos on top — an archaeology metaphor for a knowledge AI product, and a very memorable one.
works.title: Codex AI Website
